shortDescription: Mechanical and hydraulic removal tools for bearings, gears, couplings, and seized fasteners.
longDescription: ToughTorq removal tooling includes mechanical and hydraulic nut splitters, adjustable hydraulic gear pullers, coupler pullers, and matched hydraulic puller sets for controlled removal of bearings, gears, couplings, and press-fit components.
features: Matched puller sets with pumps, cylinders, hoses, and gauges
Forged puller components for industrial service

operatingRequirements.label: Tool Selection
operatingRequirements.value: Match component diameter, nut A/F size, required force, reach, spread, available clearance, and removal geometry

operatingRequirements.label: Hydraulic Models
operatingRequirements.value: Use compatible 700 bar / 10,000 psi pumps, hoses, gauges, and couplers where external hydraulic power is required

compatibility: Puller capacity, reach, spread, jaw geometry, and component engagement must match the removal application.
Nut splitters must be selected by nut A/F dimension and bolt diameter.
Hydraulic pumps, hoses, cylinders, and splitters must share compatible pressure ratings and connection interfaces.
